title: Airframes
description: Which airframe wears which livery, and when: one file per airline. An airframe not listed wears its airline's current standard livery.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, as a relative path.

airline.description: The airline's ICAO code; the file is airframes/<airline>.json.

airframes.description: Each tagged airframe: the jets that wear something other than the airline's current standard scheme.

registration.description: The airframe's registration, as painted (N123AB, G-XLEA).

hex.description: ICAO 24-bit address, lowercase. Absent when not confirmed.

livery.description: A livery id: 'id' for this airline's, or 'ICAO/id' for any other airline's (a regional in its mainline partner's, a freighter operator in its customer's, an alliance's).

from.description: When it was painted; absent when not found.

to.description: Repainted or retired; absent while it's still flying in it.

lastSeen.description: The latest date it was seen in this livery, as evidence it's current.

confidence.description: How sure the tag is: high from an official source or a recent dated photo of the jet, medium from older photos or good secondary sources, low from inference alone (docs/UPDATING.md).

sources.description: Where the tag comes from, each with when it was read.

title.description: What it is: a photo's caption and credit, a page's title.

note.description: What this source shows or supports.

notes.description: Public remarks for a reader. No private process notes.

hexSource.description: Where the hex came from, e.g. the national register, or a community database (not checked against the register).

art.description: Artwork on this airframe within its scheme, where every jet differs (Frontier's tail animals): what it is, its name, and how to draw it simply.

name.description: Its name as painted, e.g. 'Elijah the Elk'.

subject.description: What it shows, e.g. 'Rocky Mountain elk'.

family.description: For a simple silhouette: the animal's shape family.

colors.description: Its main colors as painted, most area first (hex).

place.description: The part the artwork is on.
